name: provenship
description: End-to-end development pipeline: brainstorm -> plan -> build (TDD, subagents) -> review -> browser QA (UI + API) -> evidence-rich finalize -> ship. Hand it a requirement, get back a PR with proof.

interface.shortDescription: Drive a requirement end-to-end to a reviewed, QA'd, shipped PR.
interface.longDescription: An orchestrator that drives a feature or bugfix through six phases — brainstorm, plan, build (TDD + subagents), review, browser QA, and ship — with Karpathy discipline throughout. Phases 1-4 run on Codex; browser QA and ship depend on gstack, which is Claude-Code-only (run the front half here and ship by hand).
defaultPrompt: Ship this feature end-to-end with Provenship.
Use Provenship to plan and build this.
